info.name: Langflow < 1.9.0 - Remote Code Execution
author: himind
info.description: Langflow versions prior to 1.9.0 are vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) via the build_public_tmp endpoint.

request:
GET /api/v1/version HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:7860
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Debian; Linux i686) AppleWebKit/537.36
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 63
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 06:16:23 GMT
Server: uvicorn

{"version":"1.8.1","main_version":"1.8.1","package":"Langflow"}
